title: 200L Planted Amazon Biotope
description: A lush 200-liter Amazon biotope aquarium designed for a client who wanted a slice of the Rio Negro in their living room. We used blackwater parameters with Indian almond leaves, driftwood from the Amazon basin, and a careful selection of cardinal tetras, corydoras, and angelfish. The plant palette included Amazon swords, java ferns, and floating frogbit to create dappled lighting conditions. A custom-built cabinet with a matte black finish houses the canister filtration and CO2 injection system.

title: Reefscape 120G Mixed Reef
description: A 120-gallon mixed reef tank featuring a curated selection of SPS and LPS corals alongside a thriving cleanup crew. The aquascape was built using dry rock and Marco Mortar to create a pillar structure with multiple caves and overhangs. Equipped with Radion XR30 lighting, a Reef Octopus skimmer, and a programmable Apex controller for automated water changes and dosing. The client wanted a low-maintenance system that still delivered a high-impact visual display.

title: 60G Nano Reef Office Tank
description: A compact 60-gallon nano reef built for a tech startup's office lobby. The focus was on visual impact with minimal footprint. We used a single island aquascape with branching montipora, zoanthids, and a elegance coral as the centerpiece. A pair of ocellaris clownfish and a firefish goby provide movement. The tank is plumbed into the building's central HVAC for temperature stability, with an AIO filtration system hidden in the custom walnut cabinet.

title: Japanese Iwagumi Nature Aquarium
description: A minimalist Iwagumi layout inspired by the Amano style, featuring three main stones (Oyaishi, Soeishi, Fukuseki) arranged in perfect asymmetry. A dense carpet of Monte Carlo was grown emersed before flooding, with a background of Rotala wallichii adding depth. The tank runs on a pressurized CO2 system with a drop checker maintaining 30ppm. A shoal of 50 celestial pearl danios provides scale against the hardscape.

title: Pond Conversion: Koi & Native Plants
description: A complete backyard pond renovation converting a neglected 3000-gallon koi pond into a balanced ecosystem. We redesigned the filtration system with a settlement chamber, moving bed biofilter, and a UV sterilizer. Native marginal plants were added around the perimeter for natural filtration and aesthetic appeal. A new liner, bottom drain system, and rock waterfall feature completed the transformation. The client's prize koi now thrive in crystal-clear water year-round.

title: Custom 400L Southeast Asian Blackwater
description: A custom 400-liter blackwater biotope replicating the peat swamps of Southeast Asia. Dark tannin-stained water, leaf litter, and twisted bogwood create an authentic habitat for a breeding group of Betta macrostoma and Trigonostigma heteromorpha. The filtration is peat-filtered to maintain pH below 5.0, with dim LED lighting to simulate the dense canopy cover of the natural habitat. A fogger adds atmospheric mist above the water surface.
